name: byo-keys
description: Bring Your Own Key pattern for LLM-powered web applications. Container only — the real packages are in packages/*, and the root pnpm workspace includes them directly (see pnpm-workspace.yaml).
_comment: No scripts here on purpose. This started life as a standalone turbo monorepo; every script called `turbo`, there is no turbo.json, so all of them failed — which is why CI had to hand-pick which packages to test. `pnpm -r` recurses into packages/byo-keys/packages/* directly, so the aggregator scripts were redundant as well as broken.
